title: routes.json: every watched route
description: One entry per route in the routes table (active and dormant; routes are never deleted, D23), sorted by key. Origin pages and destination hubs are views over this list.

status.description: dormant: no prices for 30 days, not collected; the page stays with a notice.

airports.description: Arrival airports from the provider catalogue (may be empty).

months.description: Per departure month with history, ascending. Typical low = median of daily lows (D3); average = mean of the same daily lows, context only. Both null while the month has fewer than meta.detector.min_baseline_days days: say so instead of a number.

days.description: Days with a low behind the numbers.

cheapest.description: Cheapest offer within the route's rules in the latest run, found within meta.detector.max_offer_age_days ("a partir de" on origin pages). null when there is none.

calendar.description: Calendar of the cheapest found prices (D30): per departure date from the export day on (the Lisbon date of meta.generated_at), the cheapest offer of the latest run within the route's rules and found within meta.detector.max_offer_age_days (the same offers as `cheapest`), ascending by date. Empty when there is none.

observations.description: Stored offers on the route, all time.

low_prices.description: Rows of this route in its origin's low-price file.

demand.description: Passengers carried on the route's airport pair, from Eurostat avia_par_pt (D45; reuse authorised with the source acknowledged). A passenger count is never a price: no eur field here. null when Eurostat has no series for the pair (small routes are not disseminated) or the dataset was never fetched: the page then shows nothing about demand.

pax_month.description: Mean passengers per month over `months` (a month without a value counts as 0).

period.description: The last month in `months`: the latest the dataset has (it lags about two years).

months.description: The dataset's last twelve months, ascending; pax 0 = no passengers reported (a seasonal route, or one that ended).
